condition_5_reading.question: which sealed record does 'acquired, verified, learned, and applied end to end' read?
condition_5_reading.rationale: the allocation's verb is 'applied' and the word 'improved' appears nowhere in condition 5; 22C's improvement arithmetic is 22C's own exit 5, a different sentence. Reading the improvement number into this condition would write a word into a frozen sentence, which §2.3 forbids in either direction

rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: also writes 'improved' into the frozen sentence, and makes the condition unreachable by anything §2.3 permits this sprint

condition_5_reading.taken: W0, before any candidate was generated
condition_5_reading.the_risk_this_reading_carries: it is the reading that moves condition 5 from ambiguous to holding, and both numbers were already sealed and visible when it was taken. The mitigation is that the alternative and *its* verdict are published here and re-published in the W4 assessment, so a reader can apply either without re-deriving anything

zero_zero_sixteen_eligibility.excludes: 22D W2-F1, the LOCAL_API configuration class (ledger entry L5)

zero_zero_sixteen_eligibility.rationale: 22D W2-F1 touches no Gate M condition, so spending the one approved change there licenses no re-measurement; and a schema migration would put a second variable into the single governed traversal, leaving a failure ambiguous between the loop and the migration
zero_zero_sixteen_eligibility.taken: W0, before any candidate was generated

migration_head.0016_is: a refusal, kept one by the W0 gate-owner decision

out_of_scope: any autonomous provider authority — merge, tag, deploy, active-memory write — anywhere, including 'just for the demo'
rewriting any 22D exit sentence or 22C exit arithmetic
Layer-1 scale-up, new acquisition campaigns, adapter training, any learner refit
any schema change beyond an explicitly selected 0016 candidate, which the W0 decision declined to permit
tuning any pre-registered configuration after its first measured number exists
outcome_tag_is: the programme-level Sprint 22 tag, not a sprint-local one; annotated **after** the squash merge on the merged main head, never on the wave branch (22C's release lesson), and its peeling is itself an exit criterion

re_measurement_licence.each_condition_records: whether it read a predecessor's seal or a 22E re-measurement, and why
re_measurement_licence.instrument: the frozen 22D hundred-task instrument, re-run per workload, with the landed repair as the only delta (22B W4-A1: measure the middle)
re_measurement_licence.rule: a 22E re-measurement replaces a predecessor's sealed reading **only if** a released repair affecting that measurement has landed through the governed path first — PR to protected main, merged by the gate owner, green on post-merge exact-head CI

why_amendments_are_structurally_zero: §2.1 asks the gate owner for two decisions and neither moves a threshold; §2.3 forbids rewriting any 22D exit sentence or 22C exit arithmetic, and no other amendment path exists in this plan
